description: Woodside Central is a prominent community shopping center strategically located along El Camino Real in Redwood City, California, serving the heart of Silicon Valley's affluent Peninsula communities. Spanning 80,591 square feet, this well-established center offers exceptional visibility and easy access from U.S. Highway 101, making it a convenient destination for the area's high-income residents and daytime workforce. The property features a strong mix of national retailers anchored by Target, Marshalls, and Chuck E. Cheese, complemented by smaller specialty shops and salons that cater to everyday shopping needs. Managed by Regency Centers, a leading national retail real estate company, Woodside Central benefits from professional management and strategic positioning in one of the nation's most prosperous markets. With over 1.2 million annual visits and a trade area boasting average household incomes exceeding $279,000, the center serves as a vital retail hub for families and professionals seeking quality merchandise, value shopping, and family entertainment in the San Francisco-Oakland-Fremont metropolitan area.
